name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room and pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Get into the locked room' and 'pick up the ball' are two unconditional commands with no preference cues, so both hard Existence clauses (target_room_entered and target_picked_up) are required and correctly stated; no order word appears in the task, so no Precedence is needed (the environment already forces entry before pickup). The machine's FINAL_STATES u3 correctly marks both goals met.

texts: Eventually enter the locked room containing the target.
Eventually pick up the mission's target ball.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered) -> u2
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u3
(u1, target_picked_up) -> u3
(u2, target_room_entered) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u1) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered, u2) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u3) -> 12
(u1, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
(u2, target_room_entered, u3) -> 11
